text.en: This Order may be cited as the Emergency (Religious Council and Citation and Kadis Courts Act) (Amendment) Order, 1990 and shall be deemed to deemed date have come into operation on 1st October, 1990. of commence· ment.

Section 48 of the Religious Council and Kadis Courts Act, in this Amendment of Order referred to as the Act, is amended by inserting the following section 48 of new subsection immediately after subsection ( 1) -Chapter 77. "jlA) Notwithstanding sub-paragraph (iii) of paragraph jb) of subsection (1), the Court of the Chief Kadi shall, in its civil jurisdiction, hear and determine all actions and proceedings in which one of the parties professes the Islamic religion and which relate to guardianship or custody of infants.''

The Act is amended by inserting the following new section Insertion of immediately after section 50 -new section SOA. "Guardianship 50 A. I 1) Wherever a Civil Court is required to act and custody in any action or proceeding to which subsection 1 lA) section matters under AJ. of section 48 applies, it shall refer the matter to the 4811 Court of the Chief Kadi. 12) The Court of the Chief Kadi shall thereupon, but subject to subsection (3), consider such matter and shall make and transmit to the Civil Court a written statement, certified to have been given for the purpose of that matter, containing answers to the same, and the Civil Court shall thereupon act upon that statement. 13) Subsections (2), 13) and 14) of section 50 apply to a reference under this section as they apply Chapter 11. to a reference under section 71 of the Probate and Administration Act and shall be construed subject to such modifications as may be necessary to bring them into conformity with this section.'' Made this 22nd day of November, 1990 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
